ambient_events: The desk fan turns a slow quarter-circle and gives up.
A key hangs on the board for a cabin nobody has claimed in a long time.
The register lies open. Most of the names in it are obviously not names.
Somebody moves in one of the cabins, and the whole building hears about it.
A moth ticks against the office window, on the outside, wanting in.
description: A cramped front office warm with lamplight: a check-in desk under a board of key hooks, a sagging couch, and a dead screen used as a shelf. People come here to ask Amos for a room, a name, or a way in — and mostly to find out whether he'll give them one.
name: Front Office
